cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I haven't booked our anniversary trip. Can you hear why before you get your laptop? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought you just needed help with the flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I let you think that. I was relieved when the cheap seats sold out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave the laptop shut. Is it the trip, or us?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Us. I hoped a cancellation would say it for me. Can you still sit beside me while I explain?

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 and A5 increase the honesty and ask B to remain, but A3 still-in-charge assertion does not change how A discloses.

responseLogic.evidence: A1 no booking, A3 relief at sold seats and A5 relationship doubt form a coherent sequence without inventing a cancellation.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers flight help and B4 offers attention plus a relevant distinction.

heightening.evidence: B4 asks trip or relationship; A5 names relationship and tests continued closeness.

specificity.evidence: A1 anniversary trip and B2 booking help establish partners attempting a conversation.

brevityWit.evidence: A1 voluntary please and A3 authority wrapper interrupt the vulnerable admission.
